title.value: Moving shared decision-making forward in Iran
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned in the paper, focusing on advancing shared decision-making (SDM) in Iran.
title.quote: Moving shared decision-making forward in Iran

extractions.description: The paper discusses the current state of shared decision-making (SDM) in Iran, highlighting recent developments in patients' rights and informed consent. It identifies the lack of policy and training initiatives for SDM and proposes a culturally adapted SDM model for implementation in Iran.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is related to patient-centered care and decision-making processes in the healthcare sector, specifically within Iran. There is no direct mention or focus on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Although there have been breakthroughs in patients’ rights and informed consent legislation in Iran during the last few years, there is still no policy regarding shared decision-making (SDM).

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily discusses healthcare improvement and patient decision-making advancements which do not fall under Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories.
primary_category.quote: Lastly, we propose an SDM model adapted to the Iranian context, through a consensus-building process with Iranian clinicians and SDM experts, to assist in its implementation in a culturally sensitive manner.

secondary_categories.justification: Since the primary category is not related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, secondary categories under this context do not apply.
secondary_categories.quote: The Iranian healthcare system is managed by the Ministry of Health and Medical Education.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's content does not fit any of the existing sub-categories for Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_sub_category.quote: SDM training and clinical implementation initiatives remain scarce within the country.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper is unrelated to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, therefore secondary sub-categories are not applicable.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We aim to provide an update on the current state of SDM in Iran and discuss future directions.

applications.value: Healthcare improvement through shared decision-making in Iran
applications.justification: The specific application of the study is to propose and implement a shared decision-making model in the Iranian healthcare context to enhance patient care.
applications.quote: Lastly, we propose an SDM model adapted to the Iranian context, through a consensus-building process with Iranian clinicians and SDM experts.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is centered around advancing healthcare practices, specifically improving shared decision-making in Iran.
new_primary_category.quote: We propose an SDM model adapted to the Iranian context, through a consensus-building process with Iranian clinicians and SDM experts, to assist in its implementation in a culturally sensitive manner.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The core sub-category discussed is the implementation of shared decision-making in healthcare within Iran.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: SDM training and clinical implementation initiatives remain scarce within the country.
